name: Film Blowing Machines
description: Mono- and multi-layer blown-film lines, from compact single-screw units to five-layer co-extrusion towers running to 2,300 mm and 400 kg/h.

name: Bag Making Machines
description: Heat-seal, bottom-seal, roll-bag and vest-bag converters for PE and biodegradable PBAT film, at speeds to 300 pcs/min.

name: Recycling & Lab Lines
description: Pelletizing and recycling lines that return edge-trim and scrap film to usable resin, plus a benchtop machine for lab and trial runs.

name: Flexographic Printing Machines
description: Premium CI flexographic printing lines from 2 to 8 colours, web widths 500–2000 mm, speeds to 350 m/min. Full servo gearless drive with ±0.1 mm registration on PE, PP, PET, BOPP and paper substrates.
